nom: MILK MAKEUP Cooling Water Jelly Ice Soothing Serum Stick with Niacinamide

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination-to-oily skin says the stick helps relieve redness without issue.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin (including one in a dry climate) report the stick feels cooling and moisturizing, though a couple note it is not deeply hydrating on its own and works best layered under a richer moisturizer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report good absorption and a hydrated, glowy look, with one noting no change in puffiness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea or acne-prone sensitive skin, consistently report no irritation and describe instant soothing relief.
segments.mature: A 46-year-old reviewer with dehydrated, mature skin finds it a good hydration booster that works best layered under a rich moisturizer.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer (46) uses it as a hydration booster in her routine, with no anti-aging claims made specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the jelly as hydrating and plumping, but a few specify it is light and not deeply hydrating for very dry skin, recommending layering with a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Widely reported to calm and reduce redness, including for reviewers with rosacea; no dissent found on this point.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive and dry-skin reviewers report the product feels gentle and does not irritate or disrupt their skin.
concerns.spots: Not specifically addressed by reviewers; one mentions niacinamide helping even out skin tone over time.
concerns.blemishes: Two acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and instant relief on inflamed skin; no reviewer reports breakouts caused by the product.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin say it is not too oily and absorbs without heaviness.

aspects.libelle: Not very cooling for some users

extraits.texte: I loved the feeling of this product but it quickly went from a jelly stick to almost melting into more of a jello like consistency and eventually crumbled and flew out of the container when I was trying to take the cap off one day. It flung out in my car and got like goo chunks stuck everywhere and I couldn't put it back in the tube bc thats just unsanitary. I didn't even keep it anywhere hot where it could've melted. I received it for Christmas and it's been in my work bag the whole time. I live in the northeast so definitely no weather hot enough to melt it. Milk needs to figure out the formula because this product is NOT worth it at all with how quickly it breaks.

As a 46-year-old woman with dehydrated skin, I've tried countless products, but the Milk Makeup Cooling Water Jelly Ice Serum Stick has truly impressed me. Its bouncy, jelly texture glides on effortlessly, delivering an instant cooling sensation that feels refreshing, especially during warmer months. Infused with niacinamide, aloe, and caffeine, it provides a soothing effect, helping to reduce puffiness and redness. While I appreciate its hydrating properties, I find that it works best when layered under a rich moisturizer to lock in moisture. The stick format is convenient for on-the-go application, making it easy to carry in my bag for midday touch-ups. Overall, it's a solid addition to my skincare routine, offering a quick pick-me-up for tired, dehydrated skin. * gifted by Milk
